name: DARCROWS
source:
Two large countries, Leben and Carnea, had been ruled by the kings who were men of character, and people in these countries had been living peacefully. However, Leben suddenly intruded into Carnea, and the two countries began to war.
The even fights had continued for more than six months, but when the king of Carnea died of illness, gradually Leben got the better of Carnea.
In these days, a man in a black suit visited Carnea. He had been a vice leader of the Carnea Knights, Claude, who had suddenly disappeared eight years before. His appearance had changed completely, and that made them suspicious. But when he said he had a plan to beat Leben, they gave their ears to him.
He said that they would hire experienced mercenary solders, and that the queen and princesses would sell their bodies to earn money.
The queen and her daughter accepted his plan, and they began to take his "lessons".

[Edited from [url=http://anidb.net/perl-bin/animedb.pl?show=anime&aid=1587]AniDB[/url]]
translation:
两大国——莱本和卡尼亚——一直由英明的国王统治，两国人民安居乐业。然而，莱本突然入侵卡尼亚，两国开战。势均力敌的战斗持续了半年多，但当卡尼亚国王病逝后，莱本逐渐占据上风。
就在这时，一个身穿黑衣的男人造访了卡尼亚。他曾是卡尼亚骑士团副团长克劳德，八年前突然失踪。他的外貌完全改变了，这让人起了疑心。但当他说有打败莱本的计划时，他们洗耳恭听。他说，他们会雇佣经验丰富的雇佣兵，而王后和公主们将出卖身体来赚取军费。王后和她的女儿接受了他的计划，开始接受他的"课程"。

[改编自[url=http://anidb.net/perl-bin/animedb.pl?show=anime&aid=1587]AniDB[/url]]
